brief_title: The Effectiveness of Intervention on Insulin Injection
official_title: The Effectiveness of Intervention on Insulin Injection in Insulin-naive Patients With Type 2 Diabetes: Application of the Transtheoretical Model

lead_sponsor.name: Kaohsiung Medical University Chung-Ho Memorial Hospital

intervention_names: Behavioral: TTM Intervention for Insulin Initiation
arm_groups.label: Intervention arm

primary_outcomes.time_frame: At baseline and 12 months after the intervention

brief_summary: The aim of the study is to assess the effectiveness of an intervention for insulin injection initiation based on the Transtheoretical Model (TTM) for insulin-naïve patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

(1) diagnosed with T2DM for at least half a year; (2) aged 20-70 years old; (3) controlling diabetes only through oral medication, without previous experience in insulin injection; (4) HbA1c≧8.5% as measured more than twice in a year; (5) considered suitable and recommended by the doctor to initiate insulin injection.

Exclusion Criteria:

(1) unable to communicate with language; (2) incapable of self-administering insulin injection due to visual or muscular impairment.
